baseGitHeadNote: Wave 0-3 work was committed on branch control-plane-repair before this repair. It was previously uncommitted, which broke the Wave 0 clean-clone requirement.

auditFindings.finding: POST /api/graphify/run executed a binary with a client-supplied command string and working directory, inheriting the complete server environment, with no freeze guard and no local HTTP boundary. It was the only route under src/app/api that spawned a process without a guard.
auditFindings.ownerDecision: keep the route live with restrictions instead of freezing it

auditFindings.finding: The mutation inventory was stale against the working tree, so verify-wave1-execution-freeze.mjs hard-exited with verificationSkipped=stale_mutation_inventory and routeContractStatus=fail. Every recorded Wave 0-3 PASS was historical, not current.

No browser bootstrap channel existed. POST /api/workbench/session requires AGENT_OS_WORKBENCH_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET, no launcher supplied it, and uiClient only rotates an existing session, so in a normal launch the UI could not obtain a session and no run could be started from the browser. THREAT-MODEL.md names this channel as a Wave 3 prerequisite.

Five junk files created by broken shell redirection inside source/ (r.json()), 0), x.routeId), !item.importWired, resolved) changed the release-input digest and were themselves enough to fail the Wave 1 gate.
auditFindings.disposition: deleted; sweep added to the verification steps

auditFindings.finding: The Wave 1 local HTTP boundary was applied only to the 106 frozen routes and to the Workbench. 42 mutation handlers across 36 route files had no boundary at all, so a hostile page could reach them with a simple cross-origin POST that needs no preflight, including the multipart upload POST /api/videouse/jobs.
auditFindings.disposition: fixed; authorizeLocalMutation is now the first statement of 43 mutation handlers across 37 route files and zero unguarded mutation handlers remain

auditFindings.finding: 115 UI call sites across 58 files fired at frozen routes with no warning, Antigravity offered a composer and a Run button while its runtime was unavailable, and the Setup Center and Command Palette offered actions that fail closed.
auditFindings.disposition: fixed by a generated per-route notice plus in-place disabling on the agent, Setup Center and Command Palette surfaces

auditFindings.finding: Found while running the full Playwright suite, which no earlier evidence file had run: 11 tests failed. Nine encoded the pre-repair contract that every agent surface shows a composer, and two asserted that Codex and Claude start and resume are unsupported, which the Wave 3 cutover had already made false.
auditFindings.disposition: specs updated to the current truth: a surface either offers a composer or states why it cannot, and Codex/Claude lifecycle is supported while the other three providers and all approvals stay unsupported

auditFindings.finding: Found during live verification of the new graphify guard: a refused working directory fell back to the default root instead of failing closed, so a request naming C:\Windows still executed, in the default directory. The first Playwright run passed only because that default directory does not exist on the test machine.
auditFindings.disposition: fixed; an explicitly requested directory that is refused now returns 403, and the spec asserts both the escaping-directory and missing-directory cases

graphifyControls.localBoundary: authorizeLocalMutation (loopback URL, single loopback Host matching the URL port, exact Origin match, cross-site fetch metadata denied)
graphifyControls.body: readLocalMutationJson (application/json only, Content-Length pre-check, 64 KiB streamed cap, plain JSON object required)

commandPolicy.shell: none; execFile with an argument array
deniedPatterns: absolute paths outside an allowed root

graphifyControls.workingDirectory: canonical realpath, not a symlink, existing directory, no UNC or device path, inside AGENT_OS_GRAPHIFY_ROOTS (default: AGENT_OS_FOLDERS_ROOT and the directory that contains the AGENT-OS install). A refused directory fails closed.
graphifyControls.environment: buildToolChildEnvironment: common OS keys plus an explicit model-provider allowlist, forbidden keys dropped, PYTHONPATH cleared. process.env is no longer inherited.
graphifyControls.binaryResolution: AGENT_OS_GRAPHIFY_BIN, else the first graphify.exe/.com on PATH. The extensionless bash shim and the .cmd wrapper are rejected because running them would require a shell.
graphifyControls.auditRecord: classified execution candidate with rationale in scripts/control-plane/verify-wave1-execution-freeze.mjs
graphifyControls.wave4Requirement: must move behind a Tool Gateway pre-execution approval

browserBootstrap.authorization: authorizeWorkbenchRead (loopback, Origin optional for a navigation, cross-site denied) plus validateWorkbenchBootstrapSecret on the token query parameter
browserBootstrap.response: 303 to a same-app relative path, default /, with the HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session and mutation cookies scoped to /api/workbench
browserBootstrap.tokenExposure: never in a body, never in page JavaScript; Referrer-Policy: no-referrer and the redirect removes it from the address bar
browserBootstrap.launcher: scripts/launch-agent-os.mjs generates the secret, starts next start with it, polls /api/vitals, then opens exactly one bootstrap navigation. Start Agent OS.bat and Start Agent OS.command call it.
browserBootstrap.sessionLifetime: rotation now extends the idle window to the configured TTL, capped by a hard 8-hour deadline from issuance, so a working tab no longer dies after 15 minutes

localMutationBoundary.checks: loopback URL, one loopback Host matching the URL port, an Origin that equals it exactly, cross-site fetch metadata denied

truthfulControls.manifestModule: src/lib/control-plane/frozenExecutionRoutes.ts (pure data, no imports, readable by client components)
truthfulControls.verifierGuardrail: the Wave 1 verifier now parses that module and fails if executionFreeze.ts stops importing it or declares its own copy

generatedSurfaceMap.derivation: each page's transitive local import graph, intersected with the frozen paths from the manifest and the mutation inventory

truthfulControls.shellNotice: ExecutionFrozenNotice: states that nothing is sent, nothing is queued and no run is created, that reads still work, and lists the disabled endpoints behind a details toggle

agentSurfaces.antigravity: no textarea and no Run button; reports runtime-not-available first, freeze second

globalSurfaces.setupCenter: action buttons disabled with the shared reason
globalSurfaces.commandPalette: every action disabled with the shared reason

truthfulControls.notCovered: individual buttons inside the 39 app surfaces still render behind the page notice; the route still answers 503 control_plane_execution_unavailable with runCreated false
